questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if 4K Automotive Group and the Target dealerships, Hyundai Trucks Australia or Peninsula Hyundai Trucks are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.

Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with 4K Automotive Group and/or the Target dealerships, Hyundai Trucks Australia, Peninsula Hyundai Trucks or Peninsula Motor Group.
